The decisive mistake was at step 8, made by DataAnalysis_Expert. It admitted it did not know the correct URL, then wrote a download command pointing to an invented endpoint (`https://nas.er.usgs.gov/api/v1/download?nonindigenous_aquatic_species`) instead of finding the real export link. Step 9 confirmed the failure, and the team never obtained the dataset, so no count could be produced. The earlier placeholder download was also an error, but it was made in previous attempts outside this log. Within the log, step 8 is where the team moved from diagnosis to an unverified guess that blocked progress.

AGENT: DataAnalysis_Expert
STEP: 8
